operational_definitions.continuous_score: R2 over the complete fixed out-of-fold prediction vector
operational_definitions.binary_score: ROC AUC over the complete fixed out-of-fold probability vector
operational_definitions.bootstrap_draw: sample the 23 canonical-family names with replacement and concatenate every row in each sampled family block, retaining repeated blocks
operational_definitions.bootstrap_binary_one_class_draw: retain the draw with gradeable false and null metric values; intervals and selection frequencies use only gradeable draws and report their count
operational_definitions.paired_randomization_draw: independently within each canonical family, either retain or swap the complete baseline and augmented out-of-fold prediction blocks with probability one half
operational_definitions.randomization_p_value: (1 plus count of randomized deltas at least the observed delta) divided by (draws plus 1)
operational_definitions.rank_concordance: Spearman correlation between the five full-panel contrast delta ranks and each gradeable bootstrap replicate's five contrast delta ranks, separately by target and estimator
operational_definitions.model_reliance_range: minimum and maximum full-panel delta across the preregistered random-forest and extra-trees estimators

execution.fit_order: continuous target then binary targets in dmrg, ipie_afqmc, shci, trimci order; contrasts in preregistration order; random forest then extra trees

failure_actions.degenerate_binary_fold: mark that solver-family target non-gradeable for every contrast and estimator without changing the splitter
failure_actions.fewer_than_two_gradeable_binary_bootstra: mark interval and selection frequency non-gradeable
failure_actions.identity_failure: retain both raw trees and do not promote
